abilities.name: Lacerate
abilities.description: Lacerates the enemy target, making them bleed for 75 damage over 15 sec plus 10% weapon damage per existing application of Lacerate on the target. Causes a high amount of threat. This effect stacks up to 5 times on the same target.

abilities.name: Mark of the Wild
abilities.description: Increases the friendly target's armor by 385, all attributes by 16 and all resistances by 27 for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Rejuvenation
abilities.description: Heals the target for 776 over 12 sec.

abilities.name: Thorns
abilities.description: Thorns sprout from the friendly target causing 18 Nature damage to attackers when hit. Lasts 10 min.

abilities.name: Bear Form
abilities.description:
Shapeshift into Bear Form, increasing Attack Power by 30, Armor contribution from items by 180%, and Health by 20. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various bear abilities.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

abilities.name: Demoralizing Roar
abilities.description: The druid roars, decreasing nearby enemies' melee attack power by 193. Lasts 30 sec.

abilities.name: Growl
abilities.description: Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.

abilities.name: Maul
abilities.description: Increases the druid's next attack by 128 damage.

abilities.name: Teleport: Moonglade
abilities.description: Teleports the caster to the Moonglade.

abilities.name: Enrage
abilities.description: Instantly generates 10 Rage and another 20 Rage over 10 sec, but reduces base armor by 27% in Bear Form and 16% in Dire Bear Form. The druid is considered in combat for the duration.

abilities.name: Bash
abilities.description: Stuns the target for 4 sec.

abilities.name: Cure Poison
abilities.description: Cures 1 poison effect on the target.

abilities.name: Aquatic Form
abilities.description:
Shapeshift into Aquatic Form, increasing swim speed by 50% and allowing the druid to breathe underwater. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

abilities.name: Swipe
abilities.description: Swipe 3 nearby enemies, inflicting 83 damage.

abilities.name: Faerie Fire
abilities.description: Decrease the armor of the target by 505 for 40 sec. While affected, the target cannot stealth or turn invisible.

abilities.name: Hibernate
abilities.description: Forces the enemy target to sleep for up to 40 sec. Any damage will awaken the target. Only one target can be forced to hibernate at a time. Only works on Beasts and Dragonkin.

abilities.name: Cat Form
abilities.description:
Shapeshift into Cat Form, increasing Attack Power by 12 plus Agility. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various cat abilities.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.description: Claw the enemy for 140% normal damage plus 115. Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Prowl
abilities.description: Allows the Druid to prowl around, but reduces your movement speed by 30%. Lasts until cancelled.

abilities.name: Rip
abilities.description:
Finishing move that causes damage over time. Damage increases per combo point and by your Attack Power:
 1 point : 305.4 damage over 12 sec.
 2 points: 496.8 damage over 12 sec.
 3 points: 688.2 damage over 12 sec.
 4 points: 879.6 damage over 12 sec.
 5 points: 1071 damage over 12 sec.

abilities.name: Shred
abilities.description: Shred the target, causing 200% damage plus 80 to the target. Must be behind the target. Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Soothe Animal
abilities.description: Soothes the target beast, reducing the range at which it will attack you by 10 yards. Only affects Beast targets level 70 or lower. Lasts 15 sec.

abilities.name: Ferocious Bite
abilities.description:
Finishing move that causes damage per combo point and converts each extra point of energy into 3.3 additional damage. Damage is increased by your Attack Power.
 1 point : 245-321 damage
 2 points: 426-502 damage
 3 points: 607-683 damage
 4 points: 788-864 damage
 5 points: 969-1045 damage

abilities.name: Rake
abilities.description: Rake the target for 76 damage and an additional 126 damage over 9 sec. Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Remove Curse
abilities.description: Dispels 1 Curse or Bane from a friendly target.

abilities.name: Abolish Poison
abilities.description: Attempts to cure 1 poison effect on the target, and 1 more poison effect every 2 seconds for 8 sec.

abilities.name: Challenging Roar
abilities.description: Forces all nearby enemies to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

abilities.name: Cower
abilities.description: Cower, causing no damage but lowering your threat a large amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you.

abilities.name: Travel Form
abilities.description:
Shapeshift into Travel Form, increasing movement speed by 40%. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects. Only useable outdoors.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

abilities.name: Ravage
abilities.description: Ravage the target, causing 435% damage plus 98 to the target. Must be prowling and behind the target. Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Frenzied Regeneration
abilities.description: Converts up to 10 Rage per second into health for 10 sec. Each point of Rage is converted into 1% health.

abilities.name: Pounce
abilities.description: Pounce, stunning the target for 2 sec and causing 186 damage over 18 sec. Must be prowling and behind the target. Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Dire Bear Form
abilities.description:
Shapeshift into Dire Bear Form, increasing Attack Power by 120, Armor contribution from items by 360%, and Health by 600. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various bear abilities.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

abilities.name: Hurricane
abilities.description: Creates a violent storm in the target area causing 132 Nature damage to enemies every 1 sec, and increasing the time between attacks by 20%. Lasts 10 sec. Druid must channel to maintain the spell.

abilities.name: Innervate
abilities.description: Increases the target's Mana regeneration by 400% and allows 100% of the target's Mana regeneration to continue while casting. Lasts 20 sec.

abilities.name: Primal Bite
abilities.description: Bite the target, dealing 100% normal damage plus 77 and generating a high amount of threat.

abilities.name: Wild Growth
abilities.description: Heals the target and their party for 679 over 7 sec. Party members must be within 43.5 yds of target. The amount healed is applied quickly at first, and slows down as Wild Growth reaches its full duration.

abilities.name: Barkskin
abilities.description: Your skin becomes as tough as bark. Physical damage taken is reduced by 20%. While you are protected, damaging attacks will not cause spellcasting delays. Lasts 15 sec.

abilities.name: Gift of the Wild
abilities.description: Gives the Gift of the Wild to all party and raid members, increasing armor by 385, all attributes by 16 and all resistances by 27 for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Dash
abilities.description: Increases movement speed by 60% for 15 sec. Does not break prowling.

abilities.name: Deeper Wilds
abilities.description: Decreases the mana cost of Mark of the Wild by 50% and increases its duration by 50%.

abilities.name: Feline Grace
abilities.description: Reduces damage from falling.

abilities.name: Feral Charge (Bear)
abilities.description: Charge an enemy, immobilizing them and interrupting any spell they are casting for 4 sec.

abilities.name: Insect Swarm
abilities.description: The enemy target is swarmed by insects, decreasing their chance to hit with attacks by 2% and causing 186 Nature damage over 12 sec.

abilities.name: Moonkin Form
abilities.description:
Shapeshift into Moonkin Form, increasing Omen of Clarity's chance to trigger by 100%, Armor contribution from items by 360%, and all party or raid members within 45 yards have their Critical Strike chance increased by 3%. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and prevents the use of healing spells.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

abilities.name: Nature's Grasp
abilities.description: The next 1 melee attack that strikes the caster will afflict the attacker with Entangling Roots (Rank 6). Castable while shapeshifted. Lasts 45 sec.

abilities.name: Nature's Swiftness
abilities.description: When activated, your next Nature spell becomes an instant cast spell.

abilities.name: Omen of Clarity
abilities.description: Your spells and attacks have a chance to grant you Clearcasting, reducing the Mana, Rage, or Energy cost of your next damage or healing spell or offensive ability by 100%. Clearcasting is not consumed by Wrath or by spells or abilities that cost no resources.

abilities.name: Poised
abilities.description: While at maximum Energy, and out of combat, reduce the Energy cost of your next ability by 10.

abilities.name: Swiftmend
abilities.description: Instantly heals a target with your active Rejuvenation or Regrowth effect for an amount equal to the full duration of the periodic effect.

abilities.name: Track Humanoids
abilities.description: Shows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap. Only one type of thing can be tracked at a time.

abilities.name: Auto Shot
abilities.description: Automatically shoots the target until cancelled.

abilities.name: Raptor Strike
abilities.description: A strong attack that deals melee weapon damage plus 70.

abilities.name: Track Beasts
abilities.description: Shows the location of all nearby beasts on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Aspect of the Monkey
abilities.description: The hunter takes on the aspects of a monkey, increasing chance to dodge by 8%. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Serpent Sting
abilities.description: Stings the target, causing 675 Nature damage over 15 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.

abilities.name: Arcane Shot
abilities.description: An instant shot that causes 280 Arcane damage.

abilities.name: Hunter's Mark
abilities.description: Places the Hunter's Mark on the target, increasing the Ranged Attack Power of all attackers against that target by 143. In addition, the target of this ability can always be seen by the hunter whether it stealths or turns invisible. The target also appears on the mini-map. Lasts for 2 min.

abilities.name: Concussive Shot
abilities.description: Dazes the target, slowing movement speed by 50% for 4 sec.

abilities.name: Aspect of the Hawk
abilities.description: The hunter takes on the aspects of a hawk, increasing Ranged Attack Power by 120. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Revive Pet
abilities.description: Revive your pet, returning it to life with 15% of its health.

abilities.name: Track Humanoids
abilities.description: Shows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Distracting Shot
abilities.description: Distract the target, causing threat. More effective than Distracting Shot (Rank 5).

abilities.name: Mend Pet
abilities.description: Heals your pet 245 health every second while you focus. Lasts 5 sec.

abilities.name: Wing Clip
abilities.description: Inflicts 50 damage and reduces the enemy target's movement speed by 60% for 10 sec.

abilities.name: Eyes of the Beast
abilities.description: Take direct control of your pet and see through its eyes for 2 min.

abilities.name: Immolation Trap
abilities.description: Place a Fire trap that will burn the first enemy to approach for 690 Fire damage over 15 sec. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Fire trap can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Mongoose Bite
abilities.description: Counterattack the enemy for melee weapon damage plus 57. Can only be performed after you dodge.

abilities.name: Multi-Shot
abilities.description: Fires several missiles, hitting 3 targets. Multi-Shot shares its cooldown with Aimed Shot.

abilities.name: Track Undead
abilities.description: Shows the location of all nearby undead on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Disengage
abilities.description: Attempts to disengage from the target by reducing threat. More effective than Disengage (Rank 2). Disables auto-attack.

abilities.name: Freezing Trap
abilities.description: Place a Frost trap that freezes the first enemy that approaches, preventing all action for up to 20 sec. Any damage caused will break the ice. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Frost trap can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Scorpid Sting
abilities.description: Stings the target, reducing the target's chance to hit with attacks by 2% for 20 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.

abilities.name: Track Hidden
abilities.description: Increases stealth detection and shows hidden units within detection range on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Rapid Fire
abilities.description: Increases ranged and melee attack speed by 40% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Track Elementals
abilities.description: Shows the location of all nearby elementals on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Frost Trap
abilities.description: Place a Frost trap that creates an ice slick around itself for 30 sec when the first enemy approaches it. All enemies within 10 yards will be slowed by 60% while in the area of effect. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Frost trap can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Feign Death
abilities.description: Feign death which may trick enemies into ignoring you. Lasts 6 min. If not cancelled, after 6 min you will actually die.

abilities.name: Lacerate
abilities.description: Wounds the target causing them to bleed for 406 damage over 21 sec.

abilities.name: Strider Kick
abilities.description: A powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage and increases movement speed by 30% for 3 sec.

abilities.name: Flare
abilities.description: Exposes all hidden and invisible enemies within 10 yards of the targeted area for 30 sec.

abilities.name: Track Demons
abilities.description: Shows the location of all nearby demons on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Viper Sting
abilities.description: Stings the target, draining 1108 mana over 8 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.

abilities.name: Aspect of the Pack
abilities.description: The hunter and group members within 30 yards take on the aspects of a pack of cheetahs, increasing movement speed by 30%. If a pack member takes damage, they will be dazed for 4 sec. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Sniper Shot
abilities.description: A long-range shot that deals ranged damage plus 590 and increases the range of your next 3 Shots by 10 yards for 10 sec.

abilities.name: Track Giants
abilities.description: Shows the location of all nearby giants on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Volley
abilities.description: Continuously fires a volley of ammo at the target area, causing 112 Arcane damage to enemy targets within 8 yards every 1 sec for 6 sec.

abilities.name: Aspect of the Wild
abilities.description: The hunter and all party and raid members within 30 yards take on the aspect of the wild, increasing Nature resistance by 60. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Track Dragonkin
abilities.description: Shows the location of all nearby dragonkin on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Tranquilizing Shot
abilities.description: Attempts to remove 1 Frenzy effect from an enemy creature.

abilities.name: Aimed Shot
abilities.description: An aimed shot that increases ranged damage by 350. Aimed Shot shares its cooldown with Multi-Shot.

abilities.name: Aspect of the Beast
abilities.description: You take on the aspects of a beast, becoming untrackable and increasing Melee Attack Power by 110. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Aspect of the Falcon
abilities.description:
The hunter takes on the aspects of a Falcon, increasing melee and ranged Attack Power by the same amount as their highest rank of Aspect of the Hawk.

While Aspect of the Falcon is active, the Improved Aspect of the Hawk talent can now proc from and benefit melee attacks. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Beast Lore
abilities.description: Gather information about the target beast. The tooltip will display damage, health, armor, any special resistances, and diet.

abilities.name: Bestial Wrath
abilities.description: Send your pet into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 18 sec. While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.

abilities.name: Black Arrow
abilities.description: Fires a Black Arrow into the target, slowing the target's movement speed by 70%, causing 150 Shadow damage and draining 150 mana over 30 sec.

abilities.name: Call Pet
abilities.description: Summons your pet to you.

abilities.name: Counterattack
abilities.description: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 50% weapon damage plus 110 and immobilizes the target for 5 sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

abilities.name: Deterrence
abilities.description: When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec.

abilities.name: Dismiss Pet
abilities.description: Dismiss your pet. Dismissing your pet will reduce its happiness by 50.

abilities.name: Eagle Eye
abilities.description: Zooms in the hunter's vision. Only usable outdoors. Lasts 1 min.

abilities.name: Enchanted Flare
abilities.description: Exposes all hidden and invisible enemies within 10 yards of the targeted area, and staves off magical darkness for 30 sec.

abilities.name: Feed Pet
abilities.description: Feed your pet the selected item. Feeding your pet increases happiness. Using food close to the pet's level will have a better result.

abilities.name: Heart of the Lion
abilities.description: The hunter invokes the heart of a lion, increasing total stats by 10% and Attack Power by 40 for all nearby allies, and increasing total stats for the Hunter by an additional 10%.

abilities.name: Intimidation
abilities.description: Command your pet to Stun the target for 3 sec on its next successful attack, which also gains 100% increased critical strike chance. Generates high threat.

abilities.name: Scare Beast
abilities.description: Scares a beast, causing it to run in fear for up to 20 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only one beast can be feared at a time.

abilities.name: Scatter Shot
abilities.description: A short-range shot that deals 50% weapon damage and disorients the target for 4 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect. Turns off your attack when used.

abilities.name: Tame Beast
abilities.description: Begins taming a beast to be your companion. Your armor is reduced by 100% while you focus on taming the beast for 20 sec. If you lose the beast's attention for any reason, the taming process will fail. Once tamed, the beast will be very unhappy and disloyal. Try feeding the pet immediately to make it happy.

abilities.name: Trueshot Aura
abilities.description: Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party or raid members within 45 yards by 100. Lasts 30 min.

abilities.name: Arcane Intellect
abilities.description: Increases the target's Intellect by 31 for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Chilled
abilities.description: Chills the target for 1.5 sec.

abilities.name: Frost Armor
abilities.description: Increases Armor by 200. If an enemy strikes the caster, they may have their movement slowed by 30% and the time between their attacks increased by 25% for 5 sec. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 30 min.

abilities.name: Arcane Missiles
abilities.description: Launches Arcane Missiles at the enemy, causing 209 Arcane damage each second for 5 sec.

abilities.name: Polymorph
abilities.description: Transforms the enemy into a pig, forcing it to wander around for up to 50 sec. While wandering, the pig cannot attack or cast spells but will regenerate very quickly. Any damage will transform the target back into its normal form. Only one target can be polymorphed at a time. Only works on Beasts, Humanoids and Critters.

abilities.name: Dampen Magic
abilities.description: Dampens magic used against the targeted party member, decreasing damage taken from spells by up to 135 and healing spells by up to 270. Lasts 10 min.

abilities.name: Slow Fall
abilities.description: Slows falling speed for 30 sec.

abilities.name: Amplify Magic
abilities.description: Amplifies magic used against the targeted party member, increasing damage taken from spells by up to 113 and healing spells by up to 225. Lasts 10 min.

abilities.name: Remove Lesser Curse
abilities.description: Removes 1 Curse or Bane from a friendly target.

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.description: Teleports the caster 20 yards forward, unless something is in the way. Also frees the caster from Stuns and Immobilizes.

abilities.name: Evocation
abilities.description: While channeling this spell, your mana regeneration is active and increased by 1500%. Lasts 8 sec.

abilities.name: Teleport: Ironforge
abilities.description: Teleports the caster to Ironforge.

abilities.name: Teleport: Undercity

abilities.name: Teleport: Darnassus
abilities.description: Teleports the caster to Darnassus.

abilities.name: Teleport: Thunder Bluff
abilities.description: Teleports the caster to Thunder Bluff.

abilities.name: Mage Armor
abilities.description: Increases your resistance to all magic by 15 and allows 50% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 30 min.

abilities.name: Portal: Ironforge
abilities.description: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Ironforge.

abilities.name: Portal: Orgrimmar

abilities.name: Portal: Thunder Bluff
abilities.description: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Thunder Bluff.

abilities.name: Teleport: Dalaran
abilities.description: Teleports the caster to Dalaran.

abilities.name: Arcane Brilliance
abilities.description: Infuses the target's party and raid with brilliance, increasing their Intellect by 31 for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Polymorph: Cow
abilities.description: Transforms the enemy into a cow, forcing it to wander around for up to 50 sec. While wandering, the cow cannot attack or cast spells but will regenerate very quickly. Any damage will transform the target back into its normal form. Only one target can be polymorphed at a time. Only works on Beasts, Humanoids and Critters.

abilities.name: Arcane Power
abilities.description: For the next 15 sec, your spells deal 30% more damage while costing 30% more mana to cast.

abilities.name: Cold Snap
abilities.description: Finishes the remaining cooldown on all your other Frost spells.

abilities.name: Combustion
abilities.description: When activated, this spell causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by 10%. This effect lasts until you have caused 3 non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells.

abilities.name: Expanded Intellect
abilities.description: Decreases the mana cost of Arcane Intellect by 50% and increases its duration by 50%.

abilities.name: Felfire
abilities.description: Blasts the enemy for 500 Fire damage.

abilities.name: Ice Block
abilities.description: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.

abilities.name: Presence of Mind
abilities.description: When activated, your next Mage spell with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes an instant cast spell.

abilities.name: Devotion Aura
abilities.description: Gives 735 additional armor to party members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Swift Judgement
abilities.description: Unleash the energy of a Seal spell upon an enemy. Does not consume the Seal. Refer to individual Seals for Judgement effect. Does not share a cooldown with your Judgement ability.

abilities.name: Blessing of Might
abilities.description: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing melee attack power by 133 for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Judgement
abilities.description: Unleash the energy of a Seal spell upon an enemy. Does not consume the Seal. Refer to individual Seals for Judgement effect.

abilities.name: Divine Protection
abilities.description: You are protected from all physical attacks and spells for 8 sec, but during that time you cannot attack or use physical abilities yourself. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.

abilities.name: Seal of the Crusader
abilities.description:
Fills the Paladin with the spirit of a crusader for 30 sec, granting 306 melee attack power. The Paladin also attacks 40% faster, but deals less damage with each attack. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 40 sec, increasing Holy damage taken by up to 161. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

abilities.name: Hammer of Justice

Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.

abilities.name: Lay on Hands
abilities.description: Heals a friendly target for an amount equal to the Paladin's maximum health and restores 550 of their mana. Drains all of the Paladin's remaining Mana when used, but does not interrupt Mana regeneration.

abilities.name: Righteous Fury
abilities.description: Increases all threat generated by 33%, and all threat generated by your Holy attacks by an additional 90%. Lasts 30 min.

abilities.name: Judgement of the Crusader

abilities.name: Concentration Aura

abilities.name: Judgement of Justice
abilities.description: Prevents the target from fleeing.

abilities.name: Seal of Justice
abilities.description:
Fills the Paladin with the spirit of justice for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to stun for 2 sec. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 10 sec, preventing them from fleeing. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

abilities.name: Judgement of Fury
abilities.description: Judge the target, dealing Holy damage.

abilities.name: Shadow Resistance Aura
abilities.description: Gives 60 additional Shadow resistance to all party and raid members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Judgement of Light
abilities.description: Melee attacks made against you have a chance of causing the attacker to be healed for 61.

abilities.name: Seal of Light
abilities.description:
Fills the Paladin with divine light for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to heal the Paladin for 94. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 40 sec, granting melee attacks made against the judged enemy a chance of healing the attacker for 61. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

abilities.name: Frost Resistance Aura
abilities.description: Gives 60 additional Frost resistance to all party and raid members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Divine Shield
abilities.description: Protects the paladin from all damage and spells for 12 sec, but reduces all damage you deal by 50%. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.

abilities.name: Fire Resistance Aura
abilities.description: Gives 60 additional Fire resistance to all party and raid members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Judgement of Wisdom
abilities.description: Attacks and spells used against the target have a chance of restoring 59 of the attacker's mana.

abilities.name: Seal of Wisdom
abilities.description:
Fills the Paladin with divine wisdom for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to restore 90 of the Paladin's mana. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 40 sec, granting attacks and spells used against the judged enemy a chance to restore 59 mana to the attacker. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

abilities.name: Hammer of the Righteous
abilities.description: Hammer the current target and up to 3 additional nearby targets, causing Holy damage to each equal to 3 times the damage per second of your main hand weapon. Cooldown shared with Crusader Strike.

abilities.name: Cleanse
abilities.description: Cleanses a friendly target, removing 1 poison effect, 1 disease effect, and 1 magic effect.

abilities.name: Blessing of Sacrifice
abilities.description: Places a Blessing on the party member, transfering 55 damage taken per hit to the caster. Lasts 30 sec. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Greater Blessing of Might
abilities.description: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Might, increasing melee attack power by 133 for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Greater Blessing of Wisdom
abilities.description: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Wisdom, restoring 40 mana every 5 seconds for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Greater Blessing of Kings
abilities.description: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Kings, increasing total stats by 10% for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Blessing of Kings
abilities.description: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing total stats by 10% for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Consecration
abilities.description: Consecrates the land beneath the Paladin, doing 96 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area. The first 4 enemies who enter the area will take an additional 216 damage over 8 sec.

abilities.name: Divine Favor
abilities.description: When activated, gives your next Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock spell a 100% critical effect chance.

abilities.name: Enhanced Blessings
abilities.description: Increases the duration of your Blessing of Might, Wisdom, Salvation, Sanctuary, Light, and Kings by 100% and reduces their mana cost by 50%.

abilities.name: Exorcist
abilities.description: Exorcism can now be cast on any target and has 100% increased critical strike chance against Undead and Demons.

abilities.name: Holy Shield
abilities.description: Increases chance to block by 30% for 10 sec, and deals 221 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active. Damage caused by Holy Shield causes 20% additional threat. Each block expends a charge. 4 charges.

abilities.name: Oath of Light
abilities.description: Swear an Oath to protect target ally for 5 min, increasing the healing of your Holy Light on them by up to 0, your Flash of Light by up to 0, and your Holy Shock by up to 0. Only one Oath of Light may be sworn by the Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Repentance
abilities.description: Puts the enemy target in a state of meditation, incapacitating them for up to 6 sec. Any damage caused will awaken the target. Only works against Humanoids.

abilities.name: Sanctity Aura
abilities.description: Increases Holy damage done by party members within 30 yards by 10%. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Sense Undead
abilities.description: Shows the location of all nearby undead on the minimap until cancelled. Only one type of tracking can be used at a time.

abilities.name: Templar's Bulwark
abilities.description: When activated, this ability grants you an absorb shield equal to 100% of your maximum health for 8 sec. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.

abilities.name: Turn Undead
abilities.description: The targeted undead enemy will be compelled to flee for up to 20 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only one target can be turned at a time.

abilities.name: Power Word: Fortitude
abilities.description: Power infuses the target, increasing their Stamina by 70 for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Shadow Word: Pain
abilities.description: A word of darkness that causes 762 Shadow damage over 18 sec.

abilities.name: Power Word: Shield
abilities.description: Draws on the soul of the party member to shield them, absorbing 928 damage. Lasts 30 sec. While the shield holds, spellcasting will not be interrupted by damage. Once shielded, the target cannot be shielded again for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Fade
abilities.description: Fade out, discouraging enemies from attacking you for 10 sec. More effective than Fade (rank 5).

abilities.name: Renew
abilities.description: Heals the target of 830 damage over 15 sec.

abilities.name: Confounding Flash
abilities.description: Confuses up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 3 sec. Any damage taken will break the effect.

abilities.name: Hex of Weakness
abilities.description: Weakens the target enemy, reducing melee attack power by 204 and reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 20%. Lasts 2 min

abilities.name: Starshards
abilities.description: Rains starshards down on the enemy target's head, causing 1800 Arcane damage over 6 sec.

abilities.name: Touch of Weakness
abilities.description: The next melee attack on the caster will cause 56 Shadow damage and reduce the attacker's melee attack power by the attacker by 204 for 2 min.

abilities.name: Inner Fire
abilities.description: A burst of Holy energy fills the caster, increasing armor by 1395. Each melee or ranged damage hit against the priest will remove one charge. Lasts 10 min or until 20 charges are used.

abilities.name: Cure Disease
abilities.description: Removes 1 disease from the friendly target.

abilities.name: Psychic Scream
abilities.description: The caster lets out a psychic scream, causing 5 enemies within 8 yards to flee for 8 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

abilities.name: Dispel Magic
abilities.description: Dispels magic on the target, removing 2 harmful spells from a friend or 2 beneficial spells from an enemy.

abilities.name: Devouring Plague
abilities.description: Afflicts the target with a disease that causes 848 Shadow damage over 24 sec. Damage caused by the Devouring Plague heals the caster.

abilities.name: Elune's Grace
abilities.description: Reduces the chance you'll be hit by melee and ranged attacks by 50% for 15 sec or until you are missed 3 times.

abilities.name: Fear Ward
abilities.description: Wards the friendly target against Fear. The next Fear effect used against the target will fail, using up the ward. Lasts 3 min.

abilities.name: Feedback
abilities.description: The priest becomes surrounded with anti-magic energy. Any successful spell cast against the priest will burn 105 of the attacker's Mana, causing 1 Shadow damage for each point of Mana burned. Lasts 15 sec.

abilities.name: Shackle Undead
abilities.description: Shackles the target undead enemy for up to 50 sec. The shackled unit is unable to move, attack or cast spells. Any damage caused will release the target. Only one target can be shackled at a time.

abilities.name: Shadowguard
abilities.description: The caster is surrounded by shadows. When a spell, melee or ranged attack hits the caster, the attacker will be struck for 96 Shadow damage. Attackers can only be damaged once every few seconds. This damage causes no threat. 3 charges. Lasts 10 min.

abilities.name: Mind Vision
abilities.description: Allows the caster to see through the target's eyes for 1 min. Will not work if the target is in another instance or on another continent.

abilities.name: Mind Control
abilities.description: Controls a humanoid mind up to level 62, but increases the time between attacks by 25%. Lasts up to 1 min.

abilities.name: Penance
abilities.description: Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 92 Holy damage to an enemy, or 425 healing to an ally, instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec.

abilities.name: Shadow Protection
abilities.description: Increases the target's resistance to Shadow spells by 60 for 10 min.

abilities.name: Abolish Disease
abilities.description: Attempts to cure 1 disease effect on the target, and 1 more disease effect every 5 seconds for 20 sec.

abilities.name: Levitate
abilities.description: Allows the caster to levitate, floating a few feet above the ground. While levitating, you will fall at a reduced speed and travel over water-like surfaces. Mounting or any damage taken will cancel the effect. Lasts 2 min.

abilities.name: Prayer of Fortitude
abilities.description: Power infuses all party and raid members, increasing their Stamina by 70 for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Prayer of Shadow Protection
abilities.description: Power infuses all party and raid members, increasing their Shadow resistance by 60 for 20 min.

abilities.name: Prayer of Spirit
abilities.description: Power infuses all party and raid members, increasing their Spirit by 40 for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Divine Spirit
abilities.description: Holy power infuses the target, increasing their Spirit by 40 for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Increased Fortitude
abilities.description: Decreases the mana cost of Power Word: Fortitude by 50% and increases its duration by 50%.

abilities.name: Inner Focus
abilities.description: When activated, reduces the Mana cost of your next spell by 100% and increases its critical effect chance by 25% if it is a non-periodic spell and capable of a critical effect.

abilities.name: Lightwell
abilities.description: Creates a holy Lightwell near the priest. Members of your raid or party can click the Lightwell to restore 1600 health over 10 sec. Being attacked cancels the effect. Lightwell lasts for 3 min or 5 charges.

abilities.name: Mind Flay
abilities.description: Assault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 390 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%.

abilities.name: Power Infusion
abilities.description: Infuses the target with power, increasing their spell damage and healing done by 20% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Shadowfiend
abilities.description: Creates a shadowy fiend to attack the target. Caster receives 5% mana when the Shadowfiend attacks. Lasts 15 sec.

abilities.name: Shadowform
abilities.description: Assume Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 10%, reducing the Mana cost of all Shadow spells by 50%, increasing the critical strike damage bonus of your Shadow spells by 100%, and reducing Physical damage taken by you by 15%. However, you may not cast healing spells while in this form.

abilities.name: Silence
abilities.description: Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 sec and interrupting their spellcasts for 3 sec.

abilities.name: Vampiric Embrace
abilities.description: Afflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 10% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 30 sec. You receive 100% increased healing on yourself from this effect.

abilities.name: Sinister Strike
abilities.description: An instant strike that causes 68 damage in addition to your normal weapon damage. Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Stealth
abilities.description: Allows the rogue to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 30%. Lasts until cancelled.

abilities.name: Backstab
abilities.description: Backstab the target, causing 150% weapon damage plus 150 to the target. Must be behind the target. Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Pick Pocket
abilities.description: Pick the target's pocket.

abilities.name: Gouge
abilities.description: Causes 75 damage, stops your attack, and incapacitates the target for 4 sec. The target must be facing you. Any damage taken will break the effect. Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Evasion
abilities.description: The rogue's dodge chance will increase by 50% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Sprint
abilities.description: Increases the rogue's movement speed by 70% for 15 sec. Does not break stealth.

abilities.name: Kick
abilities.description: A quick kick that injures a single foe for 80 damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.

abilities.name: Garrote
abilities.description: Garrote the enemy, causing 552 damage over 18 sec, increased by your Attack Power. Must be stealthed and behind the target. Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Feint
abilities.description: Performs a feint, causing no damage but lowering your threat by a large amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you.

abilities.name: Ambush
abilities.description: Ambush the target, causing 250% weapon damage plus 290 to the target. Must be stealthed and behind the target. Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Distract
abilities.description: Throws a distraction, attracting the attention of all nearby enemies and reducing their Stealth detection as if they were -1 levels lower for 10 seconds. Does not break stealth.

abilities.name: Vanish
abilities.description: Allows the rogue to vanish from sight, entering an improved stealth mode for 10 sec. Also breaks movement impairing effects. More effective than Vanish (Rank 1).

abilities.name: Cheap Shot
abilities.description: Stuns the target for 4 sec. Must be stealthed. Awards 2 combo points.

abilities.name: Disarm Trap
abilities.description: Sneak up on the trap in order to disarm it. Don't get too close or the trap will go off.

abilities.name: Kidney Shot
abilities.description:
Finishing move that stuns the target. Lasts longer per combo point:
 1 point : 2 seconds
 2 points: 3 seconds
 3 points: 4 seconds
 4 points: 5 seconds
 5 points: 6 seconds

abilities.name: Blind
abilities.description: Blinds the target, causing it to wander disoriented for up to 10 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect.

abilities.name: Mutilate
abilities.description: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 90% weapon damage plus an additional 79.2 with each weapon. Damage increased by 20% against Poisoned targets. Awards 2 Combo Points.

abilities.name: Adrenaline Rush
abilities.description: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Blade Flurry
abilities.description: Increases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec.

abilities.name: Cold Blood
abilities.description: When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by 100%.

abilities.name: Detect Traps
abilities.description: Greatly increased chance to detect traps.

abilities.name: Ghostly Strike
abilities.description: A strike that deals 125% (180% if a Dagger is equipped in your Main Hand) weapon damage, increases your chance to dodge by 15% for 7 sec, and causes your next Ambush or Garrote cast within 7 sec to not require Stealth. Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Hemorrhage
abilities.description: An instant strike that deals 100% weapon damage (145% if a Dagger is equipped) and causes the target to take 15% increased Rupture and Garrote damage from the Rogue. Lasts 15 sec. Awards 1 Combo Point.

abilities.name: Poised
abilities.description: While at maximum Energy, and out of combat, reduce the Energy cost of your next ability by 10.

abilities.name: Premeditation
abilities.description: Adds 2 Combo Points to your target. You must add to or use those combo points within 20 sec or the combo points are lost.

abilities.name: Preparation
abilities.description: When activated, this ability immediately finishes the cooldown on your other Rogue abilities.

abilities.name: Redirect
abilities.description: Removes all your existing combo points from your target and stores them for up to 15 sec. These stored combat points will be transferred to the next non-player enemy you hit with a melee or ranged ability.

abilities.name: Safe Fall
abilities.description: Reduces damage from falling.

abilities.name: Rage of the Farseer
abilities.description: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 25 sec.

abilities.name: Stoneskin Totem
abilities.description: Summons a Stoneskin Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem protects party members within 30 yards, reducing Physical damage taken by 30. Lasts 5 min.

abilities.name: Earthbind Totem
abilities.description: Summons an Earthbind Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 45 sec that slows the movement speed of enemies within 10 yards.

abilities.name: Lightning Shield
abilities.description: The caster is surrounded by 3 balls of lightning. When a spell, melee or ranged attack hits the caster, the attacker will be struck for 178 Nature damage. This expends one lightning ball. Only one ball will fire every few seconds. Lasts 10 min.

abilities.name: Stoneclaw Totem
abilities.description: Summons a Stoneclaw Totem with 480 health at the feet of the caster for 15 sec that taunts creatures within 8 yards to attack it.

abilities.name: Flame Shock
abilities.description: Instantly sears the target with fire, causing 292 Fire damage immediately and 320 Fire damage over 12 sec.

abilities.name: Strength of Earth Totem
abilities.description: Summons a Strength of Earth Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem increases the strength of party or raid members within 30 yards by 53. Lasts 5 min.

abilities.name: Purge
abilities.description: Purges the enemy target, removing 2 beneficial magic effects.

abilities.name: Cure Poison
abilities.description: Cures 1 poison effect on the target.

abilities.name: Tremor Totem
abilities.description: Summons a Tremor Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that shakes the ground around it, removing Fear, Charm and Sleep effects from party members within 30 yards. Lasts 5 min.

abilities.name: Call of the Elements
abilities.description: Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar.

abilities.name: Ghost Wolf
abilities.description: Turns the Shaman into a Ghost Wolf, increasing speed by 40%. Only useable outdoors.

abilities.name: Healing Stream Totem
abilities.description: Summons a Healing Stream Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that heals group members within 30 yards for 11 every 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Totemic Recall
abilities.description: Returns your totems to the earth, giving you 25% of the mana required to cast each totem destroyed by Totemic Recall.

abilities.name: Water Shield
abilities.description:
The caster is surrounded by 3 globes of water. When a spell, melee, or ranged attack hits the caster or when one of the caster's spells gets a critical result, 2% of maximum mana is restored to the caster, expending one water globe. Only one globe will activate every few seconds. Lasts 10 min.

Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman at any one time.

abilities.name: Cure Disease
abilities.description: Cures 1 disease on the target.

abilities.name: Poison Cleansing Totem
abilities.description: Summons a Poison Cleansing Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that attempts to remove 1 poison effect from party members within 30 yards every 5 seconds. Lasts 5 min.

abilities.name: Totemic Call
abilities.description: Relocates your active totems to your location.

abilities.name: Frost Resistance Totem
abilities.description: Summons a Frost Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min. The totem increases party and raid members' frost resistance by 60, if within 30 yards.

abilities.name: Magma Totem
abilities.description: Summons a Magma Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 20 sec that causes 73 Fire damage to creatures within 8 yards every 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Mana Spring Totem
abilities.description: Summons a Mana Spring Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that restores 10 mana every 2 seconds to group members within 30 yards.

abilities.name: Fire Resistance Totem
abilities.description: Summons a Fire Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that increases the fire resistance of party or raid members within 30 yards by 60.

abilities.name: Call of the Ancestors
abilities.description: Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar. Can call different totems than Call of the Elements.

abilities.name: Grounding Totem
abilities.description: Summons a Grounding Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that will redirect one harmful spell cast on a nearby party member to itself every 10 seconds. Will not redirect area of effect spells. Lasts 45 sec.

abilities.name: Nature Resistance Totem
abilities.description: Summons a Nature Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that increases the nature resistance of party and raid members within 30 yards by 60.

abilities.name: Windfury Weapon
abilities.description: Imbue the Shaman's weapon with wind. Each hit has a 20% chance of granting you 2 extra attacks with 333 extra melee attack power. Lasts for 60 minutes.

abilities.name: Sentry Totem
abilities.description: Summons an immobile Sentry Totem with 100 health at your feet for 5 min that allows vision of nearby area and warns of enemies that attack it. Right-Click on buff to switch back and forth between totem sight and Shaman sight.

abilities.name: Windwall Totem
abilities.description: Summons a Windwall Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem protects party members within 30 yards, reducing ranged damage taken by 64. Lasts 5 min.

abilities.name: Disease Cleansing Totem
abilities.description: Summons a Disease Cleansing Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that attempts to remove 1 disease effect from party members within 30 yards every 5 seconds. Lasts 5 min.

abilities.name: Call of the Spirits
abilities.description: Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar. Can call different totems than Call of the Elements or Call of the Ancestors.

abilities.name: Riptide
abilities.description: Heals a friendly target for 805 over 15 sec, and increases the effectiveness of your Chain Heal casts directly on that target by 25%.

abilities.name: Grace of Air Totem
abilities.description: Summons a Grace of Air Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem increases the agility of party or raid members within 30 yards by 89. Lasts 5 min.

abilities.name: Far Sight
abilities.description: Changes the caster's viewpoint to the targeted location. Lasts 1 min. Only useable outdoors.

abilities.name: Flametongue Weapon
abilities.description: Imbue the Shaman's weapon with fire. Each hit causes 31.44 to 99.92 additional Fire damage, based on the speed of the weapon. Slower weapons cause more fire damage per swing. Lasts for 60 minutes.

abilities.name: Frostbrand Weapon
abilities.description: Imbue the Shaman's weapon with frost. Each hit has a chance of causing 158 additional Frost damage and slowing the target's movement speed by 25% for 8 sec. Lasts for 60 minutes.

abilities.name: Lightning Mastery
abilities.description: Gain mastery over Lightning, reducing the cast time of your Lightning Bolt spell by -0.5 sec, and removing the cooldown from your Chain Lightning spell. Lasts 15 sec.

abilities.name: Mana Tide Totem
abilities.description: Summons a Mana Tide Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 12 sec that restores 290 mana every 3 seconds to group members within 30 yards.

abilities.name: Nature's Swiftness
abilities.description: When activated, your next Nature spell with a casting time less than 10 sec. becomes an instant cast spell.

abilities.name: Rockbiter Weapon
abilities.description: Imbue the Shaman's weapon, increasing melee attack power by 554 and allowing melee attacks to cause additional threat when using that weapon. Lasts for 60 minutes.

abilities.name: Stormstrike
abilities.description: Instantly strike for 100% weapon damage and increase the damage you deal to the target with your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Earth Shock spell by 20% for 12 sec.

abilities.name: Water Breathing
abilities.description: Allows the target to breathe underwater for 10 min.

abilities.name: Water Walking
abilities.description: Allows the friendly target to walk across water for 10 min. Any damage will cancel the effect.

abilities.name: Bane of Havoc
abilities.description: Afflicts the target for 5 min, causing 15% of all damage done by the Warlock to other targets to also be dealt to the cursed target. Bane of Havoc is limited to 1 target, and only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

abilities.name: Demon Skin
abilities.description: Protects the caster, increasing armor by 120 and increases health regeneration by 5 health per 5 sec. for 30 min.

abilities.name: Summon Imp
abilities.description: Summons an Imp under the command of the Warlock.

abilities.name: Corruption
abilities.description: Corrupts the target, causing 438 Shadow damage over 18 sec.

abilities.name: Curse of Weakness
abilities.description: Physical damage caused by the target is reduced by 37 for 2 min. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

abilities.name: Bane of Agony
abilities.description: Afflicts the target with agony, causing 552 Shadow damage over 24 sec. This damage is dealt slowly at first, and builds up as the Bane reaches its full duration. Only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

abilities.name: Fear
abilities.description: Strikes fear in the enemy, causing it to run in fear for up to 20 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only 1 target can be feared at a time.

abilities.name: Create Healthstone
abilities.description:
Creates a Major Healthstone that can be used to instantly restore 1440 health.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Drain Soul
abilities.description: Drains the soul of the target, causing 420 Shadow damage over 15 sec. Non-trivial targets damaged by Drain Soul have a chance to grant you a Soul Shard. Non-trivial targets killed by Drain Soul will always grant you a Soul shard. Soul Shards are required for other spells.

abilities.name: Summon Voidwalker
abilities.description: Summons a Voidwalker under the command of the Warlock.

abilities.name: Health Funnel
abilities.description: Gives 153 health to the caster's pet every second for 10 sec as long as the caster channels. Generates reduced threat.

abilities.name: Curse of Recklessness
abilities.description: Curses the target with recklessness, reducing the target's armor by 505 for 2 min. Cursed enemies will not flee and will ignore Fear and Horror effects. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

abilities.name: Drain Life
abilities.description: Transfers 51 health every 1 second from the target to the caster. Lasts 5 sec.

abilities.name: Curse of the Elements
abilities.description: Curses the target for 5 min, reducing Magic resistances by 75 and increasing Magic damage taken by 10%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

abilities.name: Demon Armor
abilities.description: Protects the caster, increasing armor by 570, Shadow resistance by 15 and increases health regeneration by 15 health per 5 sec. for 30 min.

abilities.name: Rain of Fire
abilities.description: Calls down a fiery rain to burn enemies in the area of effect for 880 Fire damage over 8 sec.

abilities.name: Ritual of Summoning
abilities.description: Begins a ritual that summons the targeted group member. Requires the caster and 2 additional party members to complete the ritual. In order to participate, all players must be out of combat and right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

abilities.name: Summon Incubus
abilities.description: Summons an Incubus under the command of the Warlock.

abilities.name: Summon Succubus
abilities.description: Summons a Succubus under the command of the Warlock.

abilities.name: Drain Mana
abilities.description: Transfers 136 Mana every 1 sec from the target to the caster. Lasts 5 sec.

abilities.name: Curse of Tongues
abilities.description: Forces the target to speak in Demonic, increasing the casting time of all spells by 60%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target. Lasts 30 sec.

abilities.name: Banish
abilities.description: Banishes the enemy target, preventing all action but making it invulnerable for up to 30 sec. Only one target can be banished at a time. Only works on Demons and Elementals.

abilities.name: Create Firestone
abilities.description:
Creates a Major Firestone which can be used to enchant your weapon with Fire, increasing your spell critical strike chance by 2% and the damage done by your Fire spells by up to 21.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Subjugate Demon
abilities.description: Subjugates the target demon, up to level 62, forcing it to do your bidding. While subjugated, the time between the demon's attacks is increased by 40% and its casting speed is slowed by 30%. Lasts up to 5 min. If you repeatedly subjugate the same demon, it will become more difficult to control with each attempt.

abilities.name: Summon Felhunter
abilities.description: Summons a Felhunter under the command of the Warlock.

abilities.name: Create Spellstone
abilities.description:
Creates a Major Spellstone which can be used to enchant your weapon with Shadow, increasing your spell haste by 2% and the damage done by your Shadow spells by up to 21.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Howl of Terror
abilities.description: Howl, causing 5 enemies within 10 yds to flee in terror for 15 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

abilities.name: Death Coil
abilities.description: Causes the enemy target to run in horror for 3 sec and causes 454 Shadow damage. The caster gains 100% of the damage caused in health.

abilities.name: Inferno
abilities.description: Summons a meteor from the Twisting Nether, causing 200 Fire damage and stunning all enemy targets in the area for 2 sec. An Infernal rises from the crater, under the command of the caster for 5 min. Once control is lost, the Infernal must be Subjugated to maintain control. Can only be used outdoors.

abilities.name: Bane of Doom
abilities.description: Afflicts the target with impending doom, causing 1742 Shadow damage after 1 min. If the target dies from this damage, there is a chance that a Doomguard will be summoned. Cannot be cast on players. Only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

abilities.name: Portal of Summoning
abilities.description: Begins a ritual that creates a summoning portal. The summoning portal can be used by 2 party or raid members to summon a targeted party or raid member. The ritual portal requires the caster and 2 additional party or raid members to complete. In order to participate, all players must be out of combat and right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

abilities.name: Ritual of Doom
abilities.description: Begins a ritual that sacrifices a random participant to summon a doomguard. The doomguard must be immediately subjugated or it will attack the ritual participants. Requires the caster and 4 additional party members to complete the ritual. In order to participate, all players must right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

abilities.name: Amplify Curse
abilities.description: Increases the effect of your next Curse of Weakness or Bane of Agony by 50%, or your next Curse of Exhaustion by 20%. Lasts 30 sec.

abilities.name: Curse of Exhaustion
abilities.description: Reduces the target's movement speed by 30% for 12 sec. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

abilities.name: Demonic Sacrifice
abilities.description:
When activated, sacrifices your summoned Demon to enhance the opposing aspect of your power, granting you an effect that lasts 2 hours. The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned.

Imp: Increases your Shadow damage by 15%.

Voidwalker: Restores 2% of your total Mana every 4 sec.

Succubus/Incubus: Increases your Fire damage by 15%.

Felhunter: Restores 3% of your total Health every 4 sec.

abilities.name: Detect Invisibility
abilities.description: Allows the friendly target to detect greater invisibility for 10 min.

abilities.name: Eye of Kilrogg
abilities.description: Summons an Eye of Kilrogg and binds your vision to it. The eye moves quickly but is very fragile.

abilities.name: Fel Domination
abilities.description: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 5.5 sec and its Mana cost reduced by 50%.

abilities.name: Sense Demons
abilities.description: Shows the location of all nearby demons on the minimap until cancelled. Only one type of tracking can be used at a time.

abilities.name: Shadow Ward
abilities.description: Absorbs 920 shadow damage. Lasts 30 sec.

abilities.name: Siphon Life
abilities.description: Transfers 41 health from the target to the caster every 3 sec. Lasts 30 sec.

abilities.name: Soul Link
abilities.description: When active, 30% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Demon instead. In addition, both the Demon and the master will inflict 3% more damage. Lasts as long as the Demon is active.

abilities.name: Unending Breath
abilities.description: Allows the target to breathe underwater for 10 min.

abilities.name: Battle Shout
abilities.description: The warrior shouts, increasing the melee attack power of all party or raid members within 20 yards by 139. Lasts 3 min.

abilities.name: Battle Stance
abilities.description: A balanced combat stance.

abilities.name: Heroic Strike
abilities.description: A strong attack that increases melee damage by 157 and causes a high amount of threat.

abilities.name: Spearing Strike
abilities.description: A brutal attack that deals 75% weapon damage. Deals an additional 75% weapon damage against Giants, Dragonkin, and mounted targets. Mounted targets are dismounted.

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.description: Charge an enemy, generate 15 Rage, and Stun it for 1 sec. Cannot be used in combat.

abilities.name: Rend
abilities.description: Wounds the target causing them to bleed for 147 damage over 21 sec.

abilities.name: Thunder Clap
abilities.description: Blasts nearby enemies with thunder, increasing the time between their attacks by 20% for 30 sec and doing 103 damage to them. Will affect up to 4 targets.

abilities.name: Hamstring
abilities.description: Maims the enemy, causing 45 damage and slowing the enemy's movement by 50% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Bloodrage
abilities.description: Generates 10 rage at the cost of health, and then generates an additional 10 rage over 10 sec.

abilities.name: Sunder Armor
abilities.description: Sunders the target's armor, reducing it by 450 per Sunder Armor and causes a high amount of threat. Can be applied up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.

abilities.name: Taunt
abilities.description: Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.

abilities.name: Overpower
abilities.description: Instantly overpower the enemy, causing weapon damage plus 35. Only useable after the target dodges. The Overpower cannot be blocked, dodged or parried.

abilities.name: Shield Bash
abilities.description: Bashes the target with your shield for 45 damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 6 sec.

abilities.name: Demoralizing Shout
abilities.description: Reduces the melee attack power of all enemies within 10 yards by 196 for 45 sec.

abilities.name: Mocking Blow
abilities.description: A mocking attack that causes 93 damage, a moderate amount of threat and forces the target to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

abilities.name: Shield Block
abilities.description: Increases chance to block by 75% for 7 sec, but will only block 2 attacks.

abilities.name: Disarm
abilities.description: Disarm the enemy's weapon for 10 sec.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.description: A sweeping attack that does your weapon damage plus 50 to the target and a second nearby enemy.

abilities.name: Retaliation
abilities.description: Instantly counterattack any enemy that strikes you in melee for 15 sec. Melee attacks made from behind cannot be counterattacked. A maximum of 30 attacks will cause retaliation.

abilities.name: Slam
abilities.description: Slams the opponent, causing weapon damage plus 87.

abilities.name: Intimidating Shout
abilities.description: The warrior shouts, causing the targeted enemy to cower in fear. Up to 5 enemies within 8 yds will flee in fear. Lasts 8 sec.

abilities.name: Challenging Shout
abilities.description: Forces all nearby enemies within 10 yards to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

abilities.name: Shield Wall
abilities.description: Reduces the damage taken from all attacks by 60% for 12 sec.

abilities.name: Berserker Rage
abilities.description: The warrior enters a berserker rage, becoming immune to Fear and Incapacitate effects and generating extra rage when taking damage. Lasts 10 sec.

abilities.name: Berserker Stance
abilities.description: An aggressive stance. Critical strike chance increased by 3% and all damage taken is increased by 10%.

abilities.name: Intercept
abilities.description: Charge an enemy, causing 65 damage and stunning it for 3 sec.

abilities.name: Whirlwind
abilities.description: In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing weapon damage from both melee weapons to each enemy.

abilities.name: Pummel
abilities.description: Pummel the target for 50 damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 4 sec.

abilities.name: Recklessness
abilities.description: The warrior will gain 100% increased critical strike chance and will be immune to Fear effects for the next 15 sec, but all damage taken is increased by 20%.

abilities.name: Bloodthirst
abilities.description: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 45% of your Attack Power plus 48 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec.

abilities.name: Concussion Blow
abilities.description: Stuns the target for 5 sec.

abilities.name: Death Wish
abilities.description: When activated, increases your Physical damage done by 20% and makes you immune to Fear effects, but increases all damage you take by 5%. Lasts 30 sec.

abilities.name: Last Stand
abilities.description: When activated, this ability temporarily grants you 30% of your maximum health for 20 sec. After the effect expires, the health is lost.

abilities.name: Mortal Strike
abilities.description: A vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 160 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.

abilities.name: Reckless Swings
abilities.description: Your next 4 melee attacks generate 5 additional Rage. Lasts 8 sec.

abilities.name: Sweeping Strikes
abilities.description: Your next 5 melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent.
